_approach: Kick-free breakdown where the swung skippy hat contour is the whole groove: accented 16th closed hats, offbeat open hats, rim ghosts in the pocket, a clap on 2 and 4 in bar 1 that thins to beat 4 only in bar 2. Drop this before a riser. Ref: the vocal breakdown sections of MJ Cole 'Crazy Love', Zed Bias 'Neighbourhood'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
